desc: online_battle2_duo with foes that outlast the first half (TTYD_FOE_HP) and a slow connection both ways (a deployed relay's latency): each game judges its own half at once and takes the other's later, yet both halves land in one order on both games (Yoshi's first, then Mario's on what it left), each with both results known, so every hit and the HP it meets are the same on both
log_must: ^\[duo\] online: both halves judged before either hits; half 1 hits first
^\[duo\] half 1 hits: power \d+ \(command 2\)\n(?:.*\n){0,40}?\[duo\] half 0 hits: power \d+ \(command 2\)
log_must_not: says nothing: their units are this player's
